item.title: Show HN: My LLM kept getting blocked, so I gave it a browser that looks human
item.summary: I built an agent that was supposed to do multi-step browser work. Reason → click → type → extract. Simple. Except every time it hit a protected site, Cloudflare vaporized it in under a second. Datacenter IPs? Dead. Normal headless Chrome signatures? Dead. My agent was spending most of its tokens just trying (and failing) to look human. So I stopped using the usual tools and built something different. It’s a hosted browser session on Apify. Under the hood it’s a source-patched Chromium (CloakBrowser) sitting on a sticky residential IP, with a virtual mouse that moves in real Bezier paths instead of teleporting. You drive it with a tiny CLI that talks in accessibility-tree snapshots and stable @eN refs. No CSS selectors. No pixel coordinates. No “hope the element is still there.” export APIFY_TOKEN= # that’s literally all you need undercover-driver goto https://whatever-protected-site.com undercover-driver snapshot # clean a11y tree with @e1, @e2… undercover-driver fill @e4 "hello@example.com" undercover-driver click @e3 undercover-driver verify_cf # handles Turnstile when it appears What it is not: Another Playwright wrapper.
